notes: Upstream compiles src/ with tsc and runs `node --test dist-node/test/*.js`. The vendored .ts test files run directly on Node 24's built-in type stripping (they use only erasable syntax: annotations and `import type`), under node:test as upstream. Their `./test_constants.js` import is aliased to the vendored test_constants.ts.

Each private source module a test imports is a shim over the subject. Shims for private helpers (unsafeStringify, updateV1State, updateV7State, md5, sha1) throw when called and the tests that call them are excluded; the v35 shim's stringToBytes is a TextEncoder used only to build the excluded hash fixtures.
The time-based feature's API includes parse because v1.test.ts and v6.test.ts call it at load time and in their tests.
